implementation.preparation: Shared destination reservation precedes fallible capability payload and namespace candidate storage outside MEMORY_OBJECTS. Direct allocation prepares before backing, source transfer before escrow/pin; copy retains its existing source pin. Original containing owner disposes unused prefix after local guards.
implementation.publication: Both memory capability and namespace maps use AdmittedMap. Captured generation validation precedes authority publication. Complete mixed commit relinks object, read-borrower, namespace and capability nodes and extracts moved source payload without heap work. Authority-only test callback and allocating BTreeMap paths are removed.
implementation.retirement: Capability payload and detached exact shared authority form one owner; post-registry node free precedes authority metadata and original count refund. Source moves retain payload in PreparedSource until pin completion, disposing it before same SourceEscrow retired authority. Loan/namespace cleanup retains complete original nodes. Direct close and final pin destruction retain metadata in complete object/backing owner through physical proof; rejection/abandonment retains original backing and authority charges.
implementation.field_order_correction: Prior transfer declared destination before unused read-borrower storage. Borrower storage now precedes destination, whose payload/namespace fields precede its reservation. Ordinary cancellation disposes unused storage before shared admission refund. This is a source-level destructor-order correction, not arbitrary interruption/outer-context qualification.
